Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Lost In Space]]: a 1959 Kelly-Springfield tire magazine advertisement with the headline "the greatest joy in driving is driving WORRY-FREE!" and the line "Look for the sign of worry-free driving".

Source: [https://www.vintage-adventures.com/vintage-automotive-parts-service-ads/2988-1959-kelly-tires-ad-worry-free.html 1959 Kelly Tires Vintage Ad "Worry-Free"], Vintage Adventures. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250826040513/https://www.vintage-adventures.com/vintage-automotive-parts-service-ads/2988-1959-kelly-tires-ad-worry-free.html Internet Archive], 26 August 2025.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a reduced copy (408 by 560 pixels) of a 1959 advertisement that uses "worry-free" as ad copy, the work the card's text refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
